jobs.title: Sr. Associate, Performance Marketing
jobs.description:
At Viral Nation, we specialize in building social-first ecosystems for brands to connect with the modern consumer journey. Our integrated solutions align strategy, talent, media, and technology with culturally relevant creativity to scale the world's fastest-growing digital brands. Viral Nation offers a fluid, creative, and growth-oriented environment that will support your ambitions to apply your talents in an open, collaborative, and fast-paced culture. Our ability to stay at the forefront of the industry has fuelled our success and will guide us in paving the path forward. We're driven to push boundaries and think beyond today to deliver strategies, and we're just getting started.



While we continuously exceed our goals, we need your help – our success is only as great as our people. Strong performance leads to high expectations, and we must keep raising the bar!



The Sr. Associate brings the execution lens to an integrated Performance Marketing pod. Working closely with your Manager, you own campaign build, trafficking, daily optimization, pacing, and QA across performance marketing channels, with an emphasis on paid social, while building fluency in the overarching media plan and strategy so you can speak to both sides of the work.



What You'll Do Here:



Launch, monitor, optimize, and report on media campaigns across paid social channels, with the potential to manage paid search and programmatic campaigns where clients require.
Own daily optimization, budget pacing, and in-platform troubleshooting to keep campaigns on plan and on target.
Build and traffic campaigns accurately, owning self-QA before every launch.
Analyze performance data to refine tactics, and surface in-platform signals, risks, and opportunities to your Manager.
Support media planning with actuals, reallocations, and audience execution against the strategic media plan.
Run campaign experimentation across audiences, creative, and bidding to identify what drives performance.
Evaluate creative and recommend adjustments aligned to platform best practices and client objectives.
Join internal and external calls, speaking directly to tactical detail and in-platform campaign structure.
Be a key contributor in performance platform calls, clearly articulating active and upcoming campaign plans and implementing platform provided recommendations where applicable.
What You Need To Have:
3+ years of media buying experience within paid social. Strong working knowledge of paid search; programmatic experience a strong asset.
Strong command of the qualitative and quantitative aspects of paid media.
Proficiency in the Google / Microsoft Suite and project management tools (monday.com, Asana, or ClickUp).
Strong collaboration, communication, and organizational skills.
A keen eye for creative content and current marketing trends.
Working understanding of marketing analytics, QA, and optimization best practices.
Familiarity with AI-enabled platform features and automation (Advantage+, Performance Max, smart bidding) is a plus.
Compensation Philosophy:


At Viral Nation, compensation is structured, performance-led, and market-aligned. Pay decisions are intentional, based on role requirements, performance, and market alignment by country, and are set to maintain internal pay equity across comparable roles and levels.


Compensation progression is tied to demonstrated performance, expanded scope, and sustained contribution over time, not tenure alone. Employee compensation is reviewed regularly through formal performance reviews and check-ins to ensure alignment with role expectations and impact.

AI in Recruitment:

Viral Nation does not use AI-enabled tools to screen, assess, rank, or select candidates – our hiring teams make all hiring decisions. AI note-taking tools may be used during interviews.

DEI Commitment:



Viral Nation is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in our agency. Viral Nation welcomes applications from people with visible and non-visible disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruiting and selection process.

jobs.title: Director, Brand Marketing, Body Category, Naturium
jobs.description:
About The Company

e.l.f. Beauty's purpose is to make the world a better place for every eye, lip, and face.

Our deep commitment to clean, cruelty free beauty at an incredible value has fueled the success of our flagship brand e.l.f. Cosmetics since 2004 and driven our portfolio expansion. Today, our multi-brand portfolio includes e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN, e.l.f. Hair, Well People, Naturium and rhode.

In our Fiscal year 26, we had net sales of $1.6 Billion and our business performance has been nothing short of extraordinary with 7 consecutive years of net sales growth. This consistent, category-leading growth is a testament to the strength of our team, strategy, and portfolio of brands.

Our total compensation philosophy offers every full-time new hire competitive pay and benefits, bonus eligibility (200% of target over the last seven fiscal years), equity, flexible time off, year-round half-day Fridays, and a hybrid 3 day in office, 2 day at home work environment. We believe the combination of our unique culture, total compensation, workplace flexibility and care for the team is unmatched across not just beauty but any industry.

Visit our Career Page to learn more about our team: https://www.elfbeauty.com/work-with-us

Position Summary:

Are you obsessed with body care? Do you live for the cultural moment, the brand world, and the kind of storytelling that makes people feel something and then buy something? Do you want to build a brand, not just run a campaign?

Naturium is seeking an Director, Brand Marketing - Body Category to define and drive the global brand strategy and go-to-market vision for our body care portfolio. This is a high-impact role for a brand world builder, someone who can construct the creative and strategic architecture that makes a category feel inevitable, then activate it with precision across markets and channels.

You will own the global brand identity for Naturium body: what it stands for, how it speaks, and where it shows up. You will set the go-to-market vision, shaping how the body brand lands with consumers at every touchpoint from retail floors to cultural conversations. Reporting to the Global Brand Lead, this role operates at the highest level of brand thinking while remaining deeply connected to how strategy converts to real-world brand resonance.

Position Location: LA or NY

Responsibilities:

Global Body Category Brand Strategy

Define and own the global brand strategy for the Naturium body category establishing the brand world, narrative architecture, and long-range visionDevelop brand positioning, messaging frameworks, and creative territories that are distinctly ownable for bodyIdentify whitespace opportunities in the body category and consumer landscape that the brand can meaningfully ownServe as the global brand authority for body the final word on how the brand shows up across every market, channel, and partner


Brand World Building & Integrated Campaigns 

Architect the world of Naturium body: the aesthetic, the voice, the values, and the emotional territory the brand inhabitsDevelop and steward brand guidelines and creative standards that give the body category a coherent, magnetic identity across global touchpointsShape the cultural brand calendar identifying tentpole moments, cultural conversations, and brand-right opportunities that bring the body world to lifeForge brand partnerships, collaborator relationships, and cultural alliances that expand the body brand's universe and deepen consumer connectionChampion a brand-first approach to every consumer touchpoint, ensuring the body category has a distinct, consistent presence that is unmistakably NaturiumLead the strategic development of 360° brand campaigns for the body category setting the creative vision, brand narrative, and cultural ambition from brief through executionPartner with Creative, Social, PR, and Media teams to deliver campaigns that are culturally resonant, globally scalable, and unmistakably on-brandDefine the strategic role of each campaign moment within the larger brand narrative arc for the year


Go-To-Market Vision & Strategy

Own the go-to-market vision for the Naturium body category defining annual and seasonal brand strategies that translate global positioning into commercially powerful US market activationShape the strategic narrative for how the body brand enters, shows up, and wins in the US retail environment across mass, specialty, and DTCSet the strategic direction for key retail brand moments with partners ensuring the body brand shows up with power and coherence at every touchpoint


Brand Performance & Insight

Manage and optimize regional marketing investment across campaigns, launches, and activations, ensuring strong ROI and disciplined financial stewardshipDefine brand health metrics and success criteria that measure the strength of the body brand world, not just campaign outputsLeverage consumer, cultural, and competitive intelligence to continuously sharpen brand strategy and GTM visionBuild clear, compelling brand narratives for leadership that connect brand equity building to long-range business growthApply a rigorous, insight-led lens to ensure the body brand strategy remains culturally relevant and commercially sharp


Cross-Functional & Enterprise Leadership

Act as the strategic center of gravity for the body category aligning Global Brand, Creative, Sales, Retail, Integrated Communications, and Consumer Insights teams around a unified brand visionChampion the consumer and culture at every cross-functional table, ensuring brand decisions are rooted in deep market and human understandingMentor junior brand talent and cultivate a team culture defined by strategic rigor, creative ambition, and brand obsession

8+ years of brand strategy, brand management, or integrated brand marketing experience within beauty, personal care, or high-growth consumer brandsProven track record building brand worlds not just executing campaig

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Growth Marketing Manager Puck | Built to Lead. 

Location: Manning, IA Department: Marketing Employment Type: Full-Time Schedule: Monday - Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM 

Who We Are 

At Puck, we are Built to Lead. We are a dynamic manufacturing company committed to delivering high-quality products and fostering a team environment where every member plays a critical role in our success. If you are a technically minded problem-solver who picks up new concepts quickly and thrives when there's always something new to learn, we want to hear from you. 

What You'll Do 

The Growth Marketing Manager is out dedicated in-house marketing leader, turning company strategy into qualified pipeline, profitable mix, and measurable growth. You'll plan and direct marketing for all of our products and services, work hand in hand with Sales on priority markets and accounts, and manage the people, agencies, budget, and reporting needed to deliver the annual marketing plan. 

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include: 

 Own the annual marketing strategy, operating plan, and budget in line with company growth and profitability goals. Translate company revenue targets into market, segment, product, account, and campaign plans. Meet weekly with Sales on priority products, strategic accounts, pipeline gaps, and market feedback. Define lead qualification criteria and the Marketing-to-Sales handoff, tracking leads from first touch through close. Lead market research, customer segmentation, competitive analysis, and voice-of-customer work to uncover growth opportunities. Plan and execute integrated campaigns across digital, website, social media, email, print, video, PR, events, and demonstrations, tracking cost-per-lead and conversion by channel. Coordinate promotions and product introductions with Sales and internal teams to maximize reach in target markets. Oversee catalog, flyers, websites, videos, photography, and other sales materials, and track which ones help Sales win deals. Maintain consistent branding, messaging, and quality across all media, reviewing and approving materials before publication. Manage the marketing team, outside agencies, content and campaign calendars, and resources to meet financial and operational goals. Monitor marketing-sourced pipeline, campaign return, budget performance, and forecast accuracy, and take corrective action when results are off plan. Present concise performance reports, forecasts, risks, and recommendations to the leadership team. Provide product and market expertise and contribute to the company business plan. Ensure marketing communications follow applicable legal, copyright, privacy, advertising, and postal requirements. Other duties as assigned.  What We're Looking For 

Competencies: 

 Strategic marketing and growth planning Commercial and financial acumen Sales and marketing alignment Market research, segmentation, and voice-of-customer capability Campaign planning, measurement, and attribution Budget management and forecasting discipline Leadership, coaching, and resource management Communication proficiency (verbal, written, presentation, and executive-level) Organizational skills, initiative, teamwork, creativity, and problem solving Experience in Adobe Creative Suite Proficient in photography, videography, and photo/video editing  Required Education & Experience: 

 Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field. At least five years of progressive experience in marketing, sales and marketing, demand generation, or a related commercial field. Demonstrated experience planning and executing marketing programs, managing budgets, and reporting measurable business results. Experience leading team members, agencies, vendors, or cross-functional programs.  Preferred Education & Experience 

 Experience managing websites, social media, email marketing, and multiple media types WordPress, WooCommerce, SEO, marketing analytics, and campaign attribution experience Experience with a CRM or marketing automation platform (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce) for pipeline tracking Photography, videography, and video editing experience Experience in manufacturing, agriculture, industrial, fire, military, or other relevant markets.  Supervisory Responsibility 

This position has supervisory responsibilities. You will lead the Marketing department, including work direction, coaching, performance management, staffing recommendations, hiring, and termination decisions in accordance with company policy. 

Physical Requirements 

This is primarily a sedentary role in a professional office environment. Team members must be able to: 

 Sit for extended periods and work on a computer throughout the day Occasionally stand, walk, bend and move throughout the facility Occasionally lift files and office products up to 10lbs  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 

Work Environment 

This role operates primarily in a professional office environment and routinely uses standard office equipment. Frequent visits to areas throughout the facility, including manufacturing areas where noise levels can be loud and appropriate personal protective equipment may be required, are part of the job. 

Travel 

Occasional travel is expected for industry events, customer visits, demonstrations, conferences, agency meetings, or team activities. 

Relocation 

At this time, relocation assistance is not available for this position. We encourage candidates within a commutable distance of Manning, IA or those willing to relocate independently to apply. 

What Puck Offers You 

We believe our team members deserve a benefits package as strong as the products we build. Full-time team members are eligible for benefits beginning the first of the month following 60 days of employment. 

Health & Wellness 

 Medical insurance through Wellmark Blue Cross Blue Shield — choice of $2,000 PPO or High Deductible Health Plan

jobs.description:
Location: Hoboken NJ or San Bruno CA


Job Type: Contract


Compensation Range: $45 - 56 per hour




Join a growing retail media and advertising organization that helps brands connect with consumers through impactful omnichannel solutions. The creative team develops insights-driven marketing campaigns and experiences that build meaningful connections, engage audiences and deliver measurable results for advertisers.




The Producer leads multiple high-visibility marketing and creative projects, partnering with leadership, creative teams and cross-functional stakeholders from intake and kickoff through development, approvals and final delivery.




Working across B2B touchpoints-including events, social, digital experiences, presentations and video-this role connects creative teams with business partners to keep projects aligned and moving forward. The Producer translates business needs into actionable plans, clarifies ownership, anticipates challenges and manages shifting priorities.




The ideal candidate is organized, collaborative and solutions-oriented, with the judgment to drive decisions, adapt to change and provide the clarity teams need to deliver high-quality work.




Responsibilities:


Project Leadership & Creative Delivery


Independently manage multiple B2B creative projects from intake through final delivery across events, social, digital experiences, presentations and video.
Translate business objectives and creative strategy into clearly defined scopes, schedules, milestones, workflows and review cycles.
Proactively manage priorities, risks and dependencies, recommending solutions and driving decisions to keep projects on track.
Ensure creative teams have the information, resources and alignment needed to execute successfully.
Deliver work that meets agreed-upon objectives, timelines and quality standards.
Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Partnership
Serve as a primary connection between creative teams and cross-functional partners, establishing expectations around scope, ownership, timelines and approvals.
Communicate project status, decisions and risks proactively to support alignment and timely decision-making.
Coordinate feedback and approvals across internal teams, agencies, vendors and external partners.
Build collaborative working relationships while demonstrating sound judgment, adaptability and accountability.
Creative Operations & Process Improvement
Maintain accurate project information and visibility using Workfront, Airtable and other work management tools.
Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, simplify processes and support scalable ways of working.
Contribute to best practices that strengthen planning, prioritization and creative operations.
Qualifications:


Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
5-7 years of experience in creative project management, integrated marketing, account management, production, advertising or a related discipline.
Demonstrated success independently leading complex, cross-functional creative or marketing projects from intake through delivery.
Strong planning and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and shifting deadlines.
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills across creative teams, business partners and leadership.
Strong judgment and problem-solving skills, including the ability to anticipate challenges and recommend practical solutions.
Understanding of creative development and production processes across multiple channels.
Experience using Workfront, Airtable or comparable project management platforms.
A collaborative, adaptable approach, strong attention to detail and a commitment to high-quality work.
Experience in B2B marketing, retail media, digital media or events is a plus.

new_jobs.description:
At Viral Nation, we specialize in building social-first ecosystems for brands to connect with the modern consumer journey. Our integrated solutions align strategy, talent, media, and technology with culturally relevant creativity to scale the world's fastest-growing digital brands. Viral Nation offers a fluid, creative, and growth-oriented environment that will support your ambitions to apply your talents in an open, collaborative, and fast-paced culture. Our ability to stay at the forefront of the industry has fuelled our success and will guide us in paving the path forward. We're driven to push boundaries and think beyond today to deliver strategies, and we're just getting started.



While we continuously exceed our goals, we need your help – our success is only as great as our people. Strong performance leads to high expectations, and we must keep raising the bar!



The Sr. Associate brings the execution lens to an integrated Performance Marketing pod. Working closely with your Manager, you own campaign build, trafficking, daily optimization, pacing, and QA across performance marketing channels, with an emphasis on paid social, while building fluency in the overarching media plan and strategy so you can speak to both sides of the work.



What You'll Do Here:



Launch, monitor, optimize, and report on media campaigns across paid social channels, with the potential to manage paid search and programmatic campaigns where clients require.
Own daily optimization, budget pacing, and in-platform troubleshooting to keep campaigns on plan and on target.
Build and traffic campaigns accurately, owning self-QA before every launch.
Analyze performance data to refine tactics, and surface in-platform signals, risks, and opportunities to your Manager.
Support media planning with actuals, reallocations, and audience execution against the strategic media plan.
Run campaign experimentation across audiences, creative, and bidding to identify what drives performance.
Evaluate creative and recommend adjustments aligned to platform best practices and client objectives.
Join internal and external calls, speaking directly to tactical detail and in-platform campaign structure.

Strong collaboration, communication, and organizational skills.

AI in Recruitment:

Viral Nation does not use AI-enabled tools to screen, assess, rank, or select candidates – our hiring teams make all hiring decisions. AI note-taking tools may be used during interviews.

DEI Commitment:



Viral Nation is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in our agency. Viral Nation welcomes applications from people with visible and non-visible disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruiting and selection process.

new_jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description:
Growth Marketing Manager Puck | Built to Lead. 

Location: Manning, IA Department: Marketing Employment Type: Full-Time Schedule: Monday - Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM 

Who We Are 

At Puck, we are Built to Lead. We are a dynamic manufacturing company committed to delivering high-quality products and fostering a team environment where every member plays a critical role in our success. If you are a technically minded problem-solver who picks up new concepts quickly and thrives when there's always something new to learn, we want to hear from you. 

What You'll Do 

The Growth Marketing Manager is out dedicated in-house marketing leader, turning company strategy into qualified pipeline, profitable mix, and measurable growth. You'll plan and direct marketing for all of our products and services, work hand in hand with Sales on priority markets and accounts, and manage the people, agencies, budget, and reporting needed to deliver the annual marketing plan. 

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include: 

 Own the annual marketing strategy, operating plan, and budget in line with company growth and profitability goals. Translate company revenue targets into market, segment, product, account, and campaign plans. Meet weekly with Sales on priority products, strategic accounts, pipeline gaps, and market feedback. Define lead qualification criteria and the Marketing-to-Sales handoff, tracking leads from first touch through close. Lead market research, customer segmentation, competitive analysis, and voice-of-customer work to uncover growth opportunities. Plan and execute integrated campaigns across digital, website, social media, email, print, video, PR, events, and demonstrations, tracking cost-per-lead and conversion by channel. Coordinate promotions and product introductions with Sales and internal teams to maximize reach in target markets. Oversee catalog, flyers, websites, videos, photography, and other sales materials, and track which ones help Sales win deals. Maintain consistent branding, messaging, and quality across all media, reviewing and approving materials before publication. Manage the marketing team, outside agencies, content and campaign calendars, and resources to meet financial and operational goals. Monitor marketing-sourced pipeline, campaign return, budget performance, and forecast accuracy, and take corrective action when results are off plan. Present concise performance reports, forecasts, risks, and recommendations to the leadership team. Provide product and market expertise and contribute to the company business plan. Ensure marketing communications follow applicable legal, copyright, privacy, advertising, and postal requirements. Other duties as assigned.  What We're Looking For 

Competencies: 

 Strategic marketing and growth planning Commercial and financial acumen Sales and marketing alignment Market research, segmentation, and voice-of-customer capability Campaign planning, measurement, and attribution Budget management and forecasting discipline Leadership, coaching, and resource management Communication proficiency (verbal, written, presentation, and executive-level) Organizational skills, initiative, teamwork, creativity, and problem solving Experience in Adobe Creative Suite Proficient in photography, videography, and photo/video editing  Required Education & Experience: 

 Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field. At least five years of progressive experience in marketing, sales and marketing, demand generation, or a related commercial field. Demonstrated experience planning and executing marketing programs, managing budgets, and reporting measurable business results. Experience leading team members, agencies, vendors, or cross-functional programs.  Preferred Education & Experience 

 Experience managing websites, social media, email marketing, and multiple media types WordPress, WooCommerce, SEO, marketing analytics, and campaign attribution experience Experience with a CRM or marketing automation platform (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce) for pipeline tracking Photography, videography, and video editing experience Experience in manufacturing, agriculture, industrial, fire, military, or other relevant markets.  Supervisory Responsibility 

This position has supervisory responsibilities. You will lead the Marketing department, including work direction, coaching, performance management, staffing recommendations, hiring, and termination decisions in accordance with company policy. 

Physical Requirements 

This is primarily a sedentary role in a professional office environment. Team members must be able to: 

 Sit for extended periods and work on a computer throughout the day Occasionally stand, walk, bend and move throughout the facility Occasionally lift files and office products up to 10lbs  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 

Work Environment 

This role operates primarily in a professional office environment and routinely uses standard office equipment. Frequent visits to areas throughout the facility, including manufacturing areas where noise levels can be loud and appropriate personal protective equipment may be required, are part of the job. 

Travel 

Occasional travel is expected for industry events, customer visits, demonstrations, conferences, agency meetings, or team activities. 

Relocation 

At this time, relocation assistance is not available for this position. We encourage candidates within a commutable distance of Manning, IA or those willing to relocate independently to apply. 

What Puck Offers You 

We believe our team members deserve a benefits package as strong as the products we build. Full-time team members are eligible for benefits beginning the first of the month following 60 days of employment. 

Health & Wellness 

 Medical insurance through Wellmark Blue Cross Blue Shield — choice of $2,000 PPO or High Deductible Health Plan
